result.keyword: What's the best accounting software for a small business?
result.markdown:
For a small business in Australia, **I'd recommend Xero as the best all-round accounting software in 2026.** It's relatively easy to use, has excellent bank reconciliation, supports GST and BAS, and works well with Australian accountants and bookkeepers.

However, the best option depends on the type and size of your business.

## The 5 best accounting software options

**1\. Xero**

(Best overall)

- Excellent bank feeds and reconciliation
- GST, BAS and payroll capabilities
- Integrates with hundreds of business apps
- Good accountant and bookkeeper collaboration

Australian plans start around A\$37/month.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/au/)

**2\. MYOB**

(Best for Australian businesses with employees)

- Strong Australian tax and payroll features
- GST and BAS reporting
- Good inventory and business management options
- Established Australian accounting ecosystem

Business plans start around A\$35/month.

[MYOB website](https://www.myob.com/au)

---

- Good income and expense tracking
- Invoicing and financial reporting
- Useful integrations
- Suitable for smaller businesses and freelancers

[QuickBooks Australia](https://quickbooks.intuit.com/au/)

---
